title: diplophyllum crista-galli
intro: Diplophyllum crista-galli, commonly known as Crispgold Leptoscyphus or Crispy Gold Liverwort, is a species of liverwort, a type of non-vascular plant that belongs to the family Leptoscyphaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, prevent cancer cell growth, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Diplophyllum crista-galli include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which can help to treat various health conditions such as infections, wounds, and skin diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
